show_seconds.label: Show Seconds
show_seconds.description: Add the seconds columns. With it off the face redraws once a minute.

hour_format.label: Hour Format
hour_format.description: 24-hour counts 0-23; 12-hour counts 1-12 with no AM/PM indicator.

show_headers.label: Show Column Headers
show_headers.description: Label each group Hours / Minutes / Seconds.

show_labels.label: Show Row Legend
show_labels.description: Print the 8 / 4 / 2 / 1 row weights down the right-hand side.

show_digits.label: Show Decimal Readout
show_digits.description: Print the decimal time under the grid, one digit per column.

show_separators.label: Show Group Separators
show_separators.description: Draw a rule between the hours, minutes and seconds groups.

led_size.label: LED Size
led_size.description: Diameter of one LED, in logical pixels.

led_gap.label: LED Spacing
led_gap.description: Gap between LEDs, in logical pixels. Four LEDs plus three gaps must clear the bar thickness.

group_gap.label: Group Spacing
group_gap.description: Gap between the hours, minutes and seconds groups.

font_size.label: Text Size
font_size.description: Size of the column headers, row legend and decimal readout.

on_color.label: Lit Color
on_color.description: Color of an LED that is on.

off_color.label: Unlit Color
off_color.description: Color of an LED that is off. Also used for the group separators.

text_color.label: Text Color
text_color.description: Color of the column headers, row legend and decimal readout.

glow.label: Glow
glow.description: Blur radius applied to lit LEDs only. 0 draws hard-edged dots.

tooltip_format.label: Tooltip Format
tooltip_format.description: strftime pattern shown on hover, e.g. %A, %d %B %Y - %H:%M:%S. Empty hides the tooltip.
